description: One Hookr revenue token on Robinhood Chain (hookr.fun: a fixed-supply ERC-20 whose holders share the income of fee rights locked behind it), by its address or by an agent income door's address. It reads which Hookr tokenizer minted it (or says plainly that it is not a revenue token), its name, supply, the assets it pays in, its release period, who made it, who can still add streams, and the ERC-8004 agent linked by an income door. Each stream: what it holds (a pool's Rules ledger, a Hookr family, a Fee Beneficiary NFT, Uniswap v4 or v3 positions, another revenue token, an outside source or an agent income door), its term (locked for good, until a date the creator can move later but never earlier, or revocable) and Hookr's leg. Then where the income came from over the token's whole life, per asset: from trading (delivered by its fee doors) or put in by wallets (bonus deposits, drops, plain sends to the token or a door, payments to an agent income door), each wallet named and whether it is tied to the creator (the creator itself, the stream manager, the agent's owner or wallet, or a wallet one of them sent ETH or the same token to before it put income in; a contract is never tied by this rule). Holders and the largest holder's share. Every part not read is listed as not read, never as zero. Facts read from the chain, never a verdict.

address.description: The revenue token's address on Robinhood Chain, or an agent income door's: 0x followed by 40 hex characters
